info.brief: Functions for microphone recording via miniaudio
info.description: Functions for microphone recording via miniaudio

fields.name: device_index
fields.doc: Zero-based index of the capture device to use, as returned by mic.get_devices(). Defaults to the system default device.

fields.name: sample_rate
fields.doc: Sample rate in Hz. Usually 16000, 22050, 44100, or 48000. Defaults to 16000.

fields.name: channels
fields.doc: Number of audio channels. Must be 1 (mono) or 2 (stereo). Defaults to 1.

fields.name: max_seconds
fields.doc: Maximum number of seconds to buffer. Once reached, incoming audio is discarded. 0 or omitted means unlimited.

fields.name: noise_gate_threshold
fields.doc: Amplitude threshold in range [0.0, 1.0]. Frames whose peak amplitude falls below are silenced. Defaults to 0.

elements.name: mic.stop
elements.description: Stop audio capture and return the recorded audio as a WAV byte string.

fields.name: normalize_peak
fields.doc: Peak value to normalize recorded audio to. Must be in (0.0, 1.0].

returnvalues.name: wav
returnvalues.doc: Raw WAV-encoded audio bytes, or nil if nothing was recorded.

elements.name: mic.is_recording
elements.description: Check whether the microphone is currently capturing audio.

returnvalues.name: recording
returnvalues.doc: True if currently recording, false otherwise.

elements.name: mic.is_connected
elements.description: Check whether at least one capture device is available on the system.

returnvalues.name: connected
returnvalues.doc: True if one or more capture devices are available, false otherwise.

returnvalues.name: devices
returnvalues.doc: List of device info tables, with keys 'index' and 'name'.

elements.name: mic.get_current_device
elements.description: Returns the name of the current capture device.

returnvalues.name: device
returnvalues.doc: Name of the current capture device.

elements.name: mic.get_peak
elements.description: Get the peak amplitude of the current block.

returnvalues.name: peak
returnvalues.doc: Normalised peak amplitude in the range [0.0, 1.0], or 0.0 if not recording.

elements.name: mic.get_rms
elements.description: Get the RMS (root mean square) volume of the current block.

returnvalues.name: rms
returnvalues.doc: Normalised RMS value in the range [0.0, 1.0], or 0.0 if not recording.

elements.name: mic.get_duration
elements.description: Get the duration of audio buffered so far in the current recording.

returnvalues.name: duration
returnvalues.doc: Duration in seconds, or 0.0 if not recording.

elements.name: mic.request_permission
elements.description: Request permission to use the microphone. (macOS and iOS only)

elements.name: mic.get_permission_status
elements.description: Get the current status of the permission to use the microphone. (macOS and iOS only)

returnvalues.name: status
returnvalues.doc: The current status of the permission for recording.
